findings.ac: AC1: the 3z JSON template contains plan_path
findings.text: test_3z_dispatch_json_has_plan_path_and_report_lists_it only asserts the substring 'plan_path' anywhere in the Step 2A section. The prose parenthetical (`plan_path` = the 3d plan file ...) in 3z-afk-loop.md also contains it, so the test still passes if the key \"plan_path\": \"\" is dropped from the Return JSON template. Nothing asserts the key inside the JSON object.

The AC literal uses {padded} but 3d-implement-issue.md and the test constant PLAN_FILE use `<padded>`; the AC's literal is absent from the snapshot and no assertion covers it. Likely a notation difference only, since the repo uses `<padded>` elsewhere.

findings.text: 3d line 'every planned test path must match one' (the reverse direction of the check) is not asserted. test_plan_phase_mechanical_check_uses_repo_test_paths only checks 'git ls-files' and 'Every AC needs a planned test path matching', so the reverse clause can be deleted without a failure.

findings.text: test_phase_3_compares_coverage_map_with_plan_and_writes_deviations only checks that '## Deviations' and the plan file path appear somewhere after '## Phase 3:'.
